# refusal_threshold

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Defines an immutable evidence boundary that forces policy refusal when crossed.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `threshold_id` | `string` | yes | Stable refusal threshold identity. |
| `refusal_class` | `string` | yes | Failure or risk class governed. |
| `limit` | `float` | yes | Numeric refusal boundary. |
| `metric_id` | `string` | yes | Metric compared to the boundary. |
| `authority_binding` | `string` | yes | Authority that alone may revise the threshold. |
